title: Q-CIFAIL-mergeaudit-1854: PR #1854 merged without a green checks run
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation mergeaudit --probe 1854
**Status:** open

MERGE-AUDIT-1: PR #1854 (Fix the root cause of recurring gate-skipped failures by changing the merge audit to read the full checks run status instead of mergeable_state. (#Q-RECUR-7f3c1db956)) merged at 2026-11-21T20:50:56Z with its `checks` run at `failure` on head d37aa3d. Some merge path skipped the green gate.

Fix what that run caught on main (run the failed step from .github/workflows/checks.yml locally), then confirm a later merged PR passed `checks`. Do not weaken a check.
